title: Utterly Roasted French Comte Blanquette
description: A roasted, crisp, nostalgic French dish featuring Comte cheese in a dairy-free friendly mother sauce base, served in scallop shells.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Sprinkle the flour over the onion mixture and cook for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the non-dairy milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the shredded Comte cheese until melted.
Season the sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Spoon the sauce into the scalloped shells and place on a baking sheet.
Roast the filled shells in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
